title.narrative: Furthering Gender Equality through the EU Accession Process

description.narrative: The project aims to 1. enhance the capacities of CSOs to effectively engage with governments, EUDs/EUO, and other CSOs, making these actors more aware of the gender dimensions of the EU Accession process; and 2. to improve accountability of governments and EUDs/EUO in implementing commitments to gender equality and womens rights during the EU Accession process.
